original_scenario_gates.evidence: Their separate outer hands visibly brace on the rail, their inner hands join centrally, and both shoulder-to-wrist and hip-to-knee-to-ankle chains are followable. The wide bent-knee stance and opposed upper-body lean give a plausible assisted imbalance, with B1 support observability still separately failed.

She looks up at him with an open-mouthed amused response while he turns toward her with a small closed-mouth smile. The wide awkward skating stance and reciprocal attention support a light comic encounter, without establishing actual motion or relationship history.

selected_guidance.evidence: Her open smile differs from his smaller closed-mouth smile, and his upper body is steadier than the wide bent-knee stance. However the complete scene readily reads as an ordinary affectionate cautious skating portrait. His head bends warmly toward her, and neither conspicuously dignified composure nor a strong composed-versus-mishap discrepancy is clear. The preregistered contrast is only partial; differentiated pleasant smiles alone do not pass it.
